concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Thick sediment block containing one circular opening with unornamented continuously tapering negative walls, deep small rounded bottom. Side diagnostic depicts narrow rounded termination; top appears almost cylindrical near mouth and has dark center. Hero opening visually larger relative to block than requested. Freeze opening diameter .084 m in .24 x .20 x .14 m sediment; cavity depth .112 m and small rounded basal termination. Preserve negative cavity; no almond outline. Published KGS genus description gives rounded base; specific C. conicus may have small planar apical disc. Therefore pointed-bottom means strongly converging narrow base, not unsupported mathematically sharp point. Supplement exact-GLB gray top and oblique with a labelled diagnostic half-section; main delivered GLB remains intact.
concept.hidden_surface_decisions: One fully volumetric closed sediment mesh with real top annulus and inward-facing cone wall, continuous substrate below cavity, and quiet layered outer walls. Small rounded basal cap is part of mesh; no positive cone. Diagnostic bisect is explanatory and separately recorded.
